you.en: The person or people you are talking to.

he.en: A man or boy already mentioned.

she.en: A woman or girl already mentioned.

me.en: The person speaking, as an object.

us.en: The speaker and others, as an object.

them.en: People or things already mentioned, as an object.
ex: I love my dogs. I play with them every day.
我爱我的狗，每天和它们一起玩。

his.en: Belonging to a man or boy.

its.en: Belonging to a thing or animal.
ex: The cat is playing with its tail.
那辆红色自行车是她的。
那辆蓝色的车是我们的。

what.en: Used to ask about a thing.

where.en: Used to ask about a place.

who.en: Used to ask about a person.

how.en: Used to ask about the way or condition.

ex: I go to school by bus.

have.en: To own something, or to eat or drink.

ex: I do my homework after dinner.

thank.en: To say you are happy about what someone did.

work.en: To do a job or task.
ex: My father works at a hospital.
I am happy to see you.
She was sad when her fish died.
Is it OK to sit here?

zoo.en: A place where people go to see animals.
ex: We saw a panda at the zoo.
我们在动物园看到了熊猫。

song.en: Music with words that you sing.

ex: My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
My mom reads books to me at night.

hamburger.en: Meat in a round bread bun.
ex: I want a hamburger for lunch.

ice-cream.en: A cold, sweet food made from milk.

page.en: One side of a sheet of paper in a book.
ex: Open your book to page ten.

living-room.en: The room where a family relaxes together.
ex: The cat is sleeping in the living room.

swimming-pool.en: A place filled with water for swimming.
ex: The swimming pool opens in July.

leaf.en: A flat green part of a plant.
ex: A red leaf fell from the tree.

fairy.en: A tiny magic person in stories.
ex: The fairy in the story has blue wings.
故事里的仙女有蓝色的翅膀。

yes.en: Used to say something is true or to agree.

no.en: Used to say something is not true or to refuse.
ex: No, I don't have a dog.

not.en: Used to make a sentence negative.

hi.en: A friendly way to say hello.

bye.en: A short way to say goodbye.

good-morning.en: What you say when you meet someone in the morning.

good-afternoon.en: What you say when you meet someone in the afternoon.

good-night.en: What you say before going to bed.

ex: I hope you get well soon.

luck.en: Good things that happen by chance.

each-other.en: Used to say that two people do the same thing to one another.
ex: The two friends helped each other.

march-month.en: The third month of the year.

may-month.en: The fifth month of the year.

mr.en: A title used before a man's family name.
ex: Mr. Smith is our English teacher.
史密斯先生是我们的英语老师。

mrs.zh: 太太（用于已婚女性姓氏前）
mrs.en: A title used before a married woman's family name.

will.en: Used to talk about the future.
